ministry: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas (MoPNG), Government of India
summary: PM Ujjwala Yojana 2.0 provides deposit-free LPG gas connections to adult women from economically weaker and poor households across India. The scheme provides a free connection deposit waiver, free first LPG cylinder refill, and a free two-burner gas stove (hotplate). No application fee or fee to any middleman is required.

benefits.title: Deposit-free LPG Connection
benefits.description: Security deposit for the cylinder (Rs. 1600 for 14.2kg or Rs. 1150 for 5kg) and pressure regulator is waived by the Central Government.

benefits.title: Free First LPG Refill
benefits.description: The first LPG gas cylinder refill is provided completely free of cost to the beneficiary.

benefits.title: Free Gas Stove (Hotplate)
benefits.description: A standard dual-burner LPG stove (hotplate) is provided free of cost along with the connection.

benefits.title: Safety Hose & Domestic Gas Consumer Card
benefits.description: Suraksha rubber hose pipe, inspection, and DGCC booklet are included free.

eligibility_criteria.rule: The applicant must be a woman who has attained the age of 18 years.
There must not be any existing LPG connection in the same household / family ration card.

The woman must belong to an eligible poor household under: SC/ST households, Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (Gramin), Most Backward Classes (MBC), Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY), Tea and Ex-Tea Garden tribes, Forest Dwellers, River Island inhabitants, or a SECC BPL list / 14-point declaration poor household.
The applicant must have an active personal bank account in a nationalized / commercial bank or Post Office with Aadhaar linkage for Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).

required_documents.name: Aadhaar Card of Woman Applicant
required_documents.purpose: Proof of Identity and Proof of Address.

required_documents.name: State Government Ration Card / Family Composition Document
required_documents.purpose: Proof of family composition and household status. If migrant family without ration card, self-declaration in Annexure-I is accepted under Ujjwala 2.0.

required_documents.name: Aadhaar of all adult family members
required_documents.purpose: Aadhaar numbers of adult family members appearing in the ration card or declaration.

required_documents.name: Bank Account Number & IFSC Code
required_documents.purpose: Bank passbook copy or statement for DBT subsidy transfer.

required_documents.name: Passport size photograph
required_documents.purpose: Recent photograph of the woman applicant for the consumer card.

process_steps.title: Prepare Documents
process_steps.description: Keep original and photocopies ready: woman applicant's Aadhaar, Ration Card, Bank Passbook, family members' Aadhaar, and 1 passport photo.

process_steps.title: Visit Nearest LPG Distributor or CSC
process_steps.description: Go to the nearest LPG agency (Indane, Bharatgas, or HP Gas) or Common Service Centre (CSC) in your village or town.

process_steps.title: Submit PMUY Application Form
process_steps.description: Collect the free Ujjwala 2.0 application form. The distributor or CSC helper will assist in filling it. Attach photocopies of your documents. No payment is required.

process_steps.title: Document Verification & Field De-duplication
process_steps.description: The gas company verifies that no other connection exists in your household and registers your consumer number in the system.

process_steps.title: Receive Free Cylinder & Stove
process_steps.description: Once approved, collect your free gas connection, filled LPG cylinder, double-burner gas stove, regulator, and safety booklet from the distributor.

helplines.label: PMUY Toll-Free Helpline
helplines.description: National toll-free customer support for Ujjwala scheme queries and assistance.

helplines.label: MoPNG National Helpline
helplines.description: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas citizen grievance & support line.

helplines.label: Emergency Gas Leak Helpline
helplines.description: Emergency number across all LPG distributors in case of gas leakage.

safety_warnings: PM Ujjwala Yojana is 100% free of charge. Do NOT pay any money, commission, or bribe to anyone.
Never share OTPs, PINs, passwords, or ATM card numbers with anyone.
Always receive a genuine Domestic Gas Consumer Card (blue/yellow book) and official receipt from authorized Indane, Bharatgas, or HP Gas distributors only.
Vaani does not collect personal data and never submits applications on your behalf. Always verify and apply at authorized distributors or pmuy.gov.in.
